description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bebiyawewa, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120060
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (all state-owned in this case), and land classification. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
